meta.name: Health Care symptom-to-condition knowledge base
meta.status: DRAFT: for prototype use only. Every weight, rule and piece of advice must be reviewed and approved by licensed physicians before real patients use it.
meta.purpose: Suggest possible causes and the right kind of doctor from reported symptoms. This is not a diagnosis.
meta.weights_note: Weights (0 to 1) are illustrative expert-style estimates, not measured clinical statistics. Clinicians should recalibrate them.

scoring.method: noisy-OR: score = 1 - product(1 - weight) over matched symptoms of a condition; before scoring, expand symptom `implies` (a matched child also matches its parent) and drop negated mentions.
rules: If a condition has required_any, it is only listed when at least one of those symptoms matched (after implies-expansion).
Show results as 'possible causes', never as a diagnosis.
Final urgency = highest tier among red_flag_rules, the best-scoring conditions' default_tier, any vulnerable-group escalation, and any LLM suggestion. Urgency can never be lowered by the LLM.
Vulnerable groups (child under 5, adult 65+, pregnancy, known chronic illness): raise urgency by one tier, and never below tier 2 when fever is present.
Negated symptoms ('no fever', 'bukhar nahi') must not count as matched.
Symptom `implies` must be expanded before matching and before red-flag evaluation.

tiers.1: Emergency: call 1122 / go to hospital now
tiers.2: Urgent: see a doctor within 24 hours
tiers.4: Self-care: home care, see a doctor if not improving

vulnerable_groups.rule: Raise urgency by one tier (never below tier 2 if fever is present) for: children under 5, adults 65+, pregnancy, known chronic illness.

emergency_message.en: This may be an emergency. Call 1122 now or go to the nearest hospital.
emergency_message.ur: یہ ایمرجنسی ہو سکتی ہے۔ ابھی 1122 پر کال کریں یا قریبی ہسپتال جائیں۔
emergency_message.rur: Yeh emergency ho sakti hai. Abhi 1122 par call karein ya qareebi hospital jayein.

disclaimer.en: This tool helps you find care. It is not medical advice or a diagnosis.
disclaimer.ur: یہ ٹول علاج تک رسائی میں مدد کرتا ہے۔ یہ طبی مشورہ یا تشخیص نہیں ہے۔
disclaimer.rur: Yeh tool ilaj tak pohanchne mein madad karta hai. Yeh tibbi mashwara ya tashkhees nahi hai.

meta.sources_to_review: WHO, Pakistan NIH and Ministry of Health guidance, and standard medical textbooks. Add citations during clinical review.

Rest and fluids. See a doctor soon if you are in a higher-risk group.
Isolate, rest and drink fluids. Test if possible.

Get a sputum test and chest X-ray. Free TB testing is available at government facilities.

Needs a doctor's review. Avoid NSAIDs and alcohol; seek emergency care for black stool or vomiting blood.
